description: This Java class 'AjaxResponse' provides a structured way to generate JSON responses for AJAX calls, including status, data entries, validation messages, and error handling.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A utility class to create standardized JSON responses for AJAX operations, with mechanisms for status codes, data, validation messages, and error reporting.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry (key-value pair) to the response data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a single key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets an error message based on a Throwable.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the AjaxResponse object into its JSON string representation.
